Supply 2.5 for weak second-order logic with its exact hypotheses (every infinite kappa, every language L, every set of at most kappa L*-sentences) and the kappa = aleph_0 form for L_omega1omega and L(Q_0) over an arbitrary language, each with a complete written proof, or a specific missing-work record for each, in the owned body/annex or the editable host w02-p02-005; preserve the restricted/general domain of each claim.
